title: Configure SAML Authentication
content_md:
# Configure SAML Authentication

Use SAML to let users sign in with your identity provider.

## Prerequisites

- An identity provider that supports SAML 2.0.
- Administrator access to the SeQuence server.

## Enable SAML

Run the following PowerShell command on the web server:

```powershell
Set-CoraSeQuenceSiteAuthentication -SiteName Runtime -AuthenticationType SAML
```

## Verify

Open the Runtime site and confirm you are redirected to the identity provider.

title: Configure SAML Authentication
content_md:
# Configure SAML Authentication

In Cora Orchestration, SAML is configured from the Administration site.

## Enable SAML

1. Go to **Administration > Authentication**.
2. Select **SAML** and upload the identity provider metadata file.

## Verify

Sign out and sign in again to confirm the redirect.

title: Error Handler Activity Fails
content_md:
# Error Handler Activity Fails

## Symptom

The Error Handler activity ends with status Failed.

## Cause

The activity has no connection to a fallback step.

## Resolution

Connect the Error Handler output to a fallback step and republish the workflow.

title: Install the SeQuence Database Using Scripts
content_md:
# Install the SeQuence Database Using Scripts

Install the database manually when the installer cannot reach SQL Server.

## Run the scripts

```powershell
Install-CoraSeQuenceDatabase -Server sql01 -Database SeQuence
```

## Next steps

Continue with the web server installation.

title: Create a Case Type
content_md:
# Create a Case Type

A case type defines the fields and stages of a case.

## Create the case type

1. Go to **Settings > Case Types**.
2. Click **New** and enter a name.

## Add stages

Add at least one stage before you publish the case type.
